population: Selected official NCDB fatal/injury collision releases, all released road-user groups, 1999-2021; conditional on a recorded fatal/injury collision.
source_selection: Exactly one selected annual release per year in data/sources.json; exclude comparator and aggregates.

class_labels.1: collision producing at least one fatality

target_eligibility_rule: Valid candidate event key and exactly one normalized observed C_SEV value, equal to 1 or 2; blanks count as observed values. Otherwise retain candidate event with null is_fatal and severity_eligible=false.
categorical_domain_semantics: Dictionary-supported canonical codes, not a whitelist that drops other observations; out-of-domain values are preserved and flagged. Numeric labels have no assumed ordinal distance.

dictionary.numeric_normalization: Trim whitespace; strip leading zeros only from digit-only strings; retain 0 for midnight; preserve all nonnumeric tokens and widths.

excluded_feature_groups: Outcome-derived aggregates or person injury labels
Casualty counts, fatality/injury counts, and target proxies
Collision configuration and number of involved vehicles (event-result descriptors)
All release, case, record, vehicle and person identifiers and source provenance
Duplicate multiplicity, quality flags, conflict flags and exception counts
Any added field without documented prediction-time availability and contract revision
conflict_policy: No first/majority/most-severe resolution. Null conflicting collision attribute and set <FIELD>_conflict=true; retain original rows and values in exceptions evidence.
identity_policy: Person/vehicle missing IDs, dummy IDs, duplicates or conflicting attributes do not remove otherwise target-valid condition-only events; preserve diagnostics, no demographic/vehicle aggregates as predictors.
missing_code_policy: Preserve blank, documented unknown U/UU, jurisdiction-unavailable X/XX, other Q/QQ, field-specific not-applicable N/NN, unresolved stars, conflicts and invalid codes as distinct states; do not create undocumented field-specific sentinel meanings.
prediction_time_assumption: Conditions are recorded in post-crash reports. A future scenario model assumes these conditions can be supplied before severity is known; operational timestamps, measurement latency and prospective availability have not been verified.
split_and_transform_policy: No imputation, encoding, resampling, feature fitting, model fitting or calibration during preparation. Define chronological development/validation/test periods later; fit transforms inside training folds only; never split one event across partitions.
